title: Permutation
description: Given a sequence of n integers, each between 1 and 5000, determine the minimum number of elements to change so that the sequence becomes a permutation of 1 through n.
input_format: First line: n (number of elements). Second line: a sequence of n integers a_i.
output_format: Print a single integer — the minimum number of changes needed to make the sequence a permutation.
expected_approach: Track which numbers from 1 to n are missing and count them — the answer is the number of missing distinct numbers.

test_cases.explanation: Need to change one element to 1 to get permutation [1,2].
Missing numbers are 2 and 4; replace two of the repeated 3's.
